audit_items.proof_trace: Every token transfer across all in-scope contracts (LegionAbstractSale, LegionFixedPriceSale, LegionSealedBidAuctionSale, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale, LegionPreLiquidOpenApplicationSale, LegionCapitalRaise, LegionTokenDistributor, LegionReferrerFeeDistributor) exclusively uses SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer / safeTransferFrom from Solady, which correctly handles non-standard ERC20 return values via low-level calls.
